Will I get a replacement or a refund?

Sent · Just now

ByRo Bot · AI

ByRo Bot · AI says:

It depends on what went wrong and your role (renter or lender):

Damage/loss/theft: The renter is usually required to repair, replace, or reimburse market value of the item – that’s more of a replacement/compensation outcome, not a renter refund.
Item arrives damaged/poor condition or misrepresented: As a renter, if you report it immediately, document with photos/video, and return it within 24 hours, you can request a refund of the rental cost (service fees aren’t refunded). If the lender doesn’t respond in 72 hours, support can step in.
Doesn’t fit: Any refund is up to the lender’s policy and is given as app credit only, not cash. If the lender clearly says “no refunds for fit,” then you won’t get one from us.
Late delivery: If the item arrives late and you report it properly, you’re generally entitled to a full refund if you return it within 24 hours of delivery; after that, you might get only a partial refund based on missed days.

So you might get replacement/repair compensation if you’re the lender with a damaged/lost item, or a refund/credit if you’re the renter and you follow the timing and evidence rules above.
